AboutPage.title: About Dr. Freud (Dr. Ayinla)
AboutPage.subtitle: Medically trained at the Université d'Abomey-Calavi. Over 8 years dedicated to examining emotional dynamics, interpersonal communication, and West African sociocultural realities.
AboutPage.quote: You can love someone deeply… and yet no longer know how to understand each other. What if the challenge isn't a lack of love, but a lack of structural understanding?
AboutPage.bioTitle: Understanding the Human Element to Master Relational Dynamics
AboutPage.bioP1: For over eight years, I have studied the intricacies of human relationships: our emotions, subtle reactions, expectations, emotional vulnerabilities, and the unseen mechanisms that shape how we love and communicate.
AboutPage.bioP2: My practice stems from a core belief: a relationship does not always improve simply by trying harder. Sometimes, transformation begins when we finally comprehend what isn't working.
AboutPage.bioP3: I guide individuals and couples through structured, compassionate, and solution-focused frameworks tailored to real-life challenges.
AboutPage.whoTitle: A Judgement-Free Space for Your Story
AboutPage.whoSubtitle: You do not have to navigate these complexities alone. This consultation is designed for you if:
AboutPage.whoItem1: You are experiencing emotional distance, silence, or recurring friction in your partnership.
AboutPage.whoItem2: Conversations frequently devolve into misunderstanding or injury despite good intentions.
AboutPage.whoItem3: You seek clarity on your partner's reactions, expectations, or unspoken family tensions.
AboutPage.whoItem4: You are navigating post-breakup transition and wish to regain personal clarity and balance.
AboutPage.goalsTitle: Core Pillars of Our Collaborative Work
AboutPage.g1Desc: Bringing clarity to what you experience by articulating unspoken feelings, subtle tensions, and core expectations.
AboutPage.g2Desc: Identifying systemic misunderstandings, repetitive conflict patterns, and habits that erode your bond.
AboutPage.g3Desc: Learning to express needs clearly, listen effectively, and navigate sensitive conversations calmly.
AboutPage.g4Desc: Moving forward with discernment using tailored reflection frameworks and practical exercises.
AboutPage.whyText1: Because your journey deserves far more than generic advice. My medical training grounds my approach in rigorous observation, clinical attention, and structured reflection.
AboutPage.whyText2: I carefully integrate the sociocultural, family, and traditional nuances unique to African societies—addressing community expectations, social pressures, and unspoken boundaries.
AboutPage.ctaTitle: The First Step Toward Clarity Starts with a Conversation
AboutPage.ctaText: You do not need to have all the answers before scheduling a session. Give yourself the opportunity to gain perspective.

CodeNoirPage.title: Code Noir Initiative
CodeNoirPage.subtitle: An AI-powered conversational accompaniment designed for relational intelligence, emotional clarity, and West African sociocultural realities—currently in active development.
CodeNoirPage.sec1Text1: Code Noir represents an intellectual and cultural framework dedicated to dissecting relationship structures, interpersonal dynamics, and emotional patterns. Rather than replacing human connection, it serves as a structured mirror for self-awareness.
CodeNoirPage.w1Desc: A secure space (text or voice) designed to articulate thoughts without judgment.
CodeNoirPage.w2Desc: Providing structured insights into repetitive patterns, emotional tensions, and actionable exploration paths.
CodeNoirPage.w3Desc: Calibrated specifically around West African family dynamics, social pressures, and relational taboos.
CodeNoirPage.n1Desc: Never a substitute for formal medical, psychiatric, or clinical diagnosis and psychotherapy.
CodeNoirPage.n2Desc: Supervised by clinical frameworks and strict ethical safety protocols.
CodeNoirPage.safetyText: Code Noir integrates rigorous safety monitoring for acute distress. In moments of severe crisis, the system halts standard dialogue to provide immediate emergency resources and human escalation pathways.
CodeNoirPage.devText: Our team is actively building, testing, and refining the core conversational frameworks, safety protocols, and sociocultural nuances. We welcome clinicians, researchers, developers, and partners who wish to contribute to this groundbreaking initiative.
CodeNoirPage.ctaText: Want to collaborate, contribute your expertise, or learn more about Code Noir's development?
